desc: Before heading out, record your planned trip here in the logbook. You state where you want to row, with which boat and with which rowers. For safety reasons this is important so that we can find you faster in case of an emergency. Other members can also see which boats are already reserved. After the trip, you complete your outing. Your outing is then automatically added to the boat statistics.
